description: Six floors in three steps, standing against the Curtain end of the row with its west flank blank all the way up — because the plot beyond it is the wall, and the estate went to the trouble of getting a party wall award for a boundary with nothing on the other side of it. The paperwork for that is framed in the estate office and is regarded there as a masterpiece. The door is at the east end of the bottom step, off Kerbstone Row, as far from the blank flank as the building can put it.
